# Havenly — full site summary

> Modern properties. Prime locations. A better way to find your next home in Morocco.
> Havenly is a real estate agency based in Casablanca, Morocco. It lists villas,
> apartments, houses, townhouses and penthouses for sale in Casablanca, Rabat,
> Marrakech, Agadir and Tangier. Every listing is visited, checked and photographed
> by the Havenly team. Prices are in US dollars.

## Home — https://havenly.pages.dev/

Hero: "Discover Your Perfect Home" — "Modern properties. Prime locations. A better
way to find your next home." Search by location, property type and price range.
About section: "More Than Just Real Estate" — trusted agency, secure transactions,
dedicated support. Featured properties and client testimonials.

## Properties — https://havenly.pages.dev/properties

Filterable by location (Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Agadir), type (Villa,
Apartment, House, Townhouse, Penthouse) and price (under $300,000; $300,000–
$500,000; over $500,000).

1. Modern Villa in Casablanca — $450,000 — 4 beds, 3 baths, 320 m² — Anfa.
   Private pool, floor-to-ceiling glass, smart home.
2. Luxury Apartment — $280,000 — 3 beds, 2 baths, 150 m² — Maârif, Casablanca.
   Concierge, gym, secure parking.
3. Family Home — $620,000 — 5 beds, 4 baths, 420 m² — Souissi, Rabat.
   Two living rooms, private garden, close to international schools.
4. Seaside Villa in Agadir — $540,000 — 4 beds, 3 baths, 380 m² — Founty.
   Infinity pool with ocean views, five minutes from the beach.
5. Penthouse in Rabat — $780,000 — 3 beds, 3 baths, 210 m² — Agdal.
   Private rooftop terrace, panoramic city views, private lift.
6. Garden Townhouse in Marrakech — $395,000 — 3 beds, 2 baths, 185 m² — Guéliz.
   Private garden with olive tree, rooftop terrace.

Each property page has a photo gallery, key facts, features, an advisor card and
a private-tour booking form (demo — no backend).

## About — https://havenly.pages.dev/about

Havenly was built to make buying a home in Morocco simpler: honest prices, every
home visited in person, one advisor from first viewing to final deed. Values:
honest advice always; local knowledge; from first viewing to final deed.

## Testimonials — https://havenly.pages.dev/testimonials

Fatima Zahra (Marrakech), Omar Haddad (Tangier), Leila Bennis (Casablanca) and
Youssef Amrani (Agadir).

## FAQ — https://havenly.pages.dev/faq

How buying with Havenly works; fees (around 6–7% on top of the price for notaire
fees, registration and commission); mortgages for non-residents; private viewings
and video tours; typical timeline of six to ten weeks; selling with Havenly;
cities covered; documents needed.
